claims.text: Hypomethylating agents (azacitidine, decitabine) may ease Sx and slow transformation to acute leukemia
claims.quote: Azacitidine and decitabine may ameliorate symptoms and decrease the rate of transformation to acute leukemia

claims.text: Decitabine/cedazuridine: oral fixed combination for intermediate- to high-risk MDS
claims.quote: Decitabine/cedazuridine is a fixed combination oral therapy for patients with intermediate- to high-risk MDS

claims.text: Azacitidine prolongs overall survival vs supportive care and conventional chemo
claims.quote: Azacitidine prolongs overall survival compared with supportive care and conventional chemotherapy.

claims.text: Luspatercept: anemia in very low- to intermediate-risk MDS w ringed sideroblasts after ESA failure
claims.quote: Luspatercept has been successful in increasing the hematocrit in patients with very low- to intermediate-risk MDS with ringed sideroblasts in whom ESA therapy has failed.

claims.text: Lenalidomide: cuts RBC transfusion needs in del(5q) MDS
claims.quote: Lenalidomide is an immunomodulator that is effective in reducing red blood cell (RBC) transfusion requirements in patients with MDS with deletion 5q syndrome.

claims.text: Imetelstat (telomerase inhibitor): lower-risk MDS w transfusion-dependent anemia not responding to, losing response to, or ineligible for ESA
claims.quote: Imetelstat, an oligonucleotide telomerase inhibitor, is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with low- to intermediate-1 risk MDS with transfusion-dependent anemia requiring ≥ 4 RBC units over 8 weeks who have not responded to or have lost response to or are ineligible for ESA.

claims.text: Ivosidenib: relapsed or refractory MDS w an IDH1 mutation
claims.quote: Ivosidenib can be used for treatment of relapsed or refractory MDS with an IDH1 mutation.
In patients with hypoplastic MDS, immunosuppression with cyclosporine with or without antithymocyte globulin (ATG) has been effective

claims.text: Allogeneic stem cell transplant: the only cure
claims.quote: Allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell is the only curative treatment for MDS.
